Minister Concludes Western Visit Focused on Defence Innovation

Listen to audio version of this article
Instaread
Sponsored by

The Minister of National Defence wrapped up a two-day tour of the western provinces this week, meeting service members, researchers, and industry leaders to highlight new investment in defence research and military infrastructure.

READ: Inside the National Defence Infrastructure Surge

The visit opened with a keynote address to business leaders announcing a new secure innovation hub where government, industry, and academia can collaborate on emerging technologies with defence applications. Officials described quantum research as a capability priority with the potential to reshape secure communications and sensing.

The tour continued at a western research centre, where the Minister met defence scientists working on autonomous systems, counter-drone technology, and advanced materials. Industry engagement sessions gave several small and medium-sized firms the chance to present flight-control software, sensor platforms, and other projects now receiving federal research assistance.

The final day featured a graduation parade for a summer training program and a tour of base facilities currently being modernized under a multi-year energy performance contract. Officials said the visit underscored the region's growing contribution to military readiness through training, research, and industrial innovation.
